title: EXCLUSIVE: ByteDance, Alibaba, Tencent place over $35 billion worth of Nvidia chip orders
script:
ByteDance, Alibaba, and Tencent just placed over thirty-five billion dollars in Nvidia chip orders.
These massive orders involve Nvidia RTX 5500 graphics cards.
Chinese firms are securing this hardware to bolster their AI inference capabilities.
These companies are working around tight US export controls on high-end silicon.
Previous supply chains relied on restricted chips, forcing this pivot toward alternative hardware.
This investment highlights how critical AI throughput has become for their domestic services.
Will these chips be enough to keep their AI competitive globally?
